proposed_comments.title: Harden the text replacement runtime and editing paths
proposed_comments.body:
### Harden the text replacement runtime and editing paths

**Severity:** `high`

Before this can merge, please harden the new Keyboard Manager text replacement paths so typed triggers stay consistent with what the target app actually receives. The reviewed fixes include preserving remap priority, clearing stale buffers on generated text/settings reloads, suppressing matching key-up events after a replacement, stopping injection on partial SendInput failure, handling AltGr and non-printing translations correctly, bounding trigger/replacement lengths, rejecting prefix-conflicting triggers, localizing the trigger display, and making edit/save rollback transactional so failed edits do not lose or duplicate mappings. Please add/keep regression coverage for these cases in the Keyboard Manager engine and editor tests.

confidence.rationale: The preserved fork review loop fixed these exact issues across commits 148e7a411 through e062ab5e7, with final Copilot review on e062ab5e71b7d25b7534d8a97e53e96cb96c13b7 reporting no new published comments and Get-UnresolvedCopilotThreads.ps1 reporting 0 unresolved Copilot threads. Targeted x64 Debug builds and focused Keyboard Manager text replacement tests passed.

test_instructions: Open PowerToys Settings > Keyboard Manager and add text replacement mappings, including one normal multi-character trigger and one short trigger that could be typed accidentally.
Verify the UI rejects empty, over-length, duplicate, and prefix-conflicting triggers and that editing an existing mapping either saves atomically or leaves the original mapping intact on failure.

Type configured triggers in a text editor with normal text, Shift-held input, AltGr characters, and after a single-key remap; verify only contiguous visible trigger text is replaced and modifier keys are not left stuck.
Toggle/reload Keyboard Manager settings while a trigger key is held and verify unmatched key-up events are not delivered to the target app.
